messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to cut v0.23.0-rc2 tag at 17:00 PT today. Please flag any blockers ASAP.

maria: what's the PR cutoff? still soft cutoff 16:30 PT?

alex: soft cutoff 16:30 yes. hard cutoff 16:50 for emergency fixes only; after that we'll cherry-pick to release/0.23.

jamal: FYI e2e flake on auth integration. if I can't fix by 16:20 can we omit the change and ship?

olivia: link the failing test and I can take a quick look.

jamal: failing test: auth/integration.test.js — segfault in setup. stacktrace pasted into PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/p/r/482

olivia: looking now. if it's test infra I'll revert the flaky commit.

release-bot: [release-bot] Reminder: annotated tag message required. include changelog highlights, upgrade/migration notes, and artifact checksums.

maria: also remember to create GH release draft and upload artifacts: `./scripts/build && ./scripts/upload-release --draft`.

alex: I'll draft the annotated tag body. keep it short: bullets for notable fixes, API changes, migrations, docs links.

jamal: important — include the DB migration note about the index rebuild and expected ~15m downtime.

olivia: I'll prepare the draft release page and add placeholders for the migration window. once the tag is pushed I can attach the blobs.

olivia: suggested local command to create annotated tag: `git tag -a v0.23.0-rc2 -m "v0.23.0-rc2: regression fixes, performance tweaks. See CHANGELOG.md"`

alex: I'll run the annotated tag and push: `git push origin v0.23.0-rc2` then open the draft release on GH.

maria: quick pre-tag checklist: CI green, changelog updated, migration note reviewed, release notes in docs/releases.

jamal: CI green on latest main run. rerunning e2e at 16:10 just in case.

olivia: target branch for any cherry-picks is `release/0.23`. tag naming for docker/images should be `redwood/inference:0.23.0-rc2` and include `sha256` checksum file.

alex: noted. we'll include docker tags and checksum in the release assets.

maria: I'll update the release checklist doc and add a note to ping infra if we need to extend the window.

jamal: PR #482 pushed with a small fix, requesting a quick review. ping me when you tag.

olivia: reviewed, LGTM :thumbsup:

release-bot: [release-bot] Draft release created (placeholder): https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/tag/v0.23.0-rc2

alex: Tag pushed and draft release created. Draft includes changelog bullets and migration note. Leaving draft for final asset upload.

maria: awesome — if anything else pops up we follow patch workflow (v0.23.0-rc2.1 etc). good work team.
